Pins live in `.prototools` (`rust = "..."`) and anywhere CI reads a Rust version (`.github/workflows/*.yml`, `rust-toolchain*`, justfile, docs/CONTRIBUTING mentions): find them all with `grep -rn "1\.99" --include=*.toml --include=*.yml --include=*.md --include=justfile .` and `grep -rn rust-version`. DO NOT change `rust-version = "1.96"` (the MSRV) in Cargo.toml: that is a separate policy decision. Install the new toolchain (proto: see .prototools/justfile; network needs dangerouslyDisableSandbox), then fix every new compiler warning and clippy lint properly (no blanket `allow`; read what the lint wants; check structurally identical sites), keeping `just lint` green on BOTH the new pin and the MSRV toolchain (`just lint` runs against the pin; also run `cargo +1.96 check --all-features` or the repo's MSRV job equivalent: see ci.yml MSRV job) . Verify by exit code: `just lint`, `just test` x2, `just rg-compare` (baselines: identifiers 59/59, questions 17/18, members 15/16, Rust fd 22/24, held-out 32/33 and 22/22, held-out Rust 35/36, rhf 14/14; answerable 206/222), `just span-invariants`, `just changesets` (toolchain bump with no user-visible change: no changeset or a patch only if code changed behavior: say which), `just deny`/`just machete`/`just typos`. Cut from origin/main: `git fetch origin && git switch -c chore/rust-1.100 origin/main`. Put 'Merge after monokl 0.8.0 is published' at the top of the PR description (release PR #119 is about to publish; merging to main first would regenerate it).
